content.short: Trail of Bits focuses on securing the world's most targeted web3 organizations and products.
content.description: Trail of Bits is a blockchain auditing company and an open source Web3 security tool developer offering a broad range of services and products. The firm helps blockchain companies harden smart contracts, gain a clearer understanding of contract storage, and identify a wide range of potential vulnerabilities. It also develops tools for Web3 developers, including a suite of open source security tools such as Slither, Manticore, and Echidna. Through its combination of auditing expertise and security tooling, Trail of Bits supports the secure development of Web3 applications.
content.meta: Trail of Bits offers blockchain auditing and open source web3 security tools. Discover Trail of Bits and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
